product_wide_rationale: Defines pre-readiness development authority, amended by CD-0089 for self-hosting and CD-0121 for planning and issue linkage. It governs how the Product is built rather than one runtime Domain.
summary: Defines development authority with CD-0089 governing self-hosting and CD-0121 governing Product-scoped planning and issue linkage. Its other authority boundaries remain in force.
title: Pre-readiness development authority
